# Brief

## Reader
A house owner who knows plumbing but has never had a well pump.

## Need
They must decide whether to fit a well pump in their house.

## After reading
They decide which taps the pump feeds and which settings to change.

## Goals
1. Know when the pump starts and stops.
2. Know which settings protect the pump.

## Format
A 2-page PDF.

## Tone
Plain and technical.

## Out of scope
Pricing. The internal project name Bluebird.

## Language, brand, author
English. No brand. Test Author.
